compilerSite.compiledMslAuditBasis: The exact assembled production NSString source was compiled with Xcode 27.0 build 27A266a, Metal 32023.921, macOS SDK 27.0, metal3.2, no-fast-math, warnings as errors, and the explicit SDK isysroot. AIR inspection proves one unflagged fadd in each Task0069 kernel. L1 retains raw sign clearing and its increasing-ordinal fold. SCATTER_ADD retains one target writer, an increasing update-ordinal filter, one loop-carried accumulator, a raw-base unaddressed select, one static output store loop, no atomics, and no other floating arithmetic.
compilerSite.offlineCompilerAudit: Accepted and pinned by compiled-msl-audit.json; its runner always sets DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer and the explicit MacOSX27.0.sdk isysroot.

floatingContract.leafTransform: raw binary32 sign-bit clear for every contributor
floatingContract.contributorOrder: strictly increasing source ordinal from zero through N-1
floatingContract.singleton: one direct raw ABS load/store and zero additions
floatingContract.operationPerLaterContributor: one explicit accumulator + contributor binary32 source site

scatterAddContract.geometry: canonical-dense rank-one D>0 data/result, canonical-dense rank-one U>0 indices/updates, axis zero, uint32-bounded extents, bytes, and dispatch
scatterAddContract.indices: materialized canonical INT32 or INT64 partition feed, completely CPU-scanned into [0,D) before any command encoding or output mutation
scatterAddContract.contributorOrder: raw base exactly once, then every matching update occurrence in strictly increasing source ordinal
scatterAddContract.unaddressed: raw base word copied without arithmetic, classification, or numeric conversion
scatterAddContract.addressed: one explicit safe binary32 accumulator + update site per matching occurrence
scatterAddContract.ownership: one target-linear output thread, one final store, no atomic operation

siteInventory.operation: load_word followed by uint sign-bit clear and as_type<float>
siteInventory.proof: Each ordinal is loaded exactly once. Integer sign clearing is the exact raw ABS transform for zero, subnormal, normal, infinity, and NaN classes without payload truncation.

The loop starts at ordinal one, advances by one while below N, and assigns the sole safe-mode addition result to the only accumulator. Thus N leaves induce exactly N-1 actual additions and no zero leaf or parallel partial sum.
The final L1 accumulator bits are stored once without numeric conversion, epsilon, finite substitution, or pre-truncation.

siteInventory.operation: one four-byte load_word before the update loop
siteInventory.proof: Each target thread owns one target and captures its base word exactly once. If no update ordinal matches, the same integer word reaches the sole store.

The loop starts at ordinal zero, increments by one through all U occurrences, and invokes the sole safe-mode addition only when the fully prevalidated index equals the owned target. Duplicate targets are not filtered.
One target-linear writer chooses the raw base word when unaddressed or the site-chain accumulator when addressed and reaches one static four-byte serialization loop. No atomic operation exists.

contributorProof.firstContributor: ordinal zero initializes accumulator from its raw ABS word
contributorProof.noDrop: There is no predicate, continue, finite-only branch, zero filter, or alternate update.
contributorProof.noSyntheticLeaf: No zero or identity accumulator is initialized.
contributorProof.noReassociation: One accumulator dependency chain, one output thread, one safe-mode addition site, and no reduction primitive fix the left-associated order.
contributorProof.singleton: N=1 bypasses the loop and stores the raw ABS word directly.

scatterContributorProof.base: one raw load before the update scan
scatterContributorProof.membership: selected == target after a complete CPU range scan
scatterContributorProof.duplicates: every matching occurrence reaches the add site; there is no uniqueness state or pass
scatterContributorProof.noReassociation: one target thread and one loop-carried accumulator fix the left-associated source order
scatterContributorProof.unaddressed: the addressed flag remains false and selects the original baseWord
scatterContributorProof.ownership: data_linear_id maps one grid thread to each target and the output store is reached once

specialValueProof.zero: Raw ABS clears either input zero sign. Every later add is represented by the exact/RNE/DAZ/FTZ site relation; raw store preserves the device-selected permitted result bits.
specialValueProof.subnormal: A raw ABS leaf remains exact. At an addition site each subnormal operand is exact or same-sign zero under DAZ, and each subnormal rounded result is exact or same-sign zero under FTZ; the Lean relation admits no third choice.
specialValueProof.normal: Every finite normal contributor enters exactly one ordinal addition, and no source branch filters, rescales, or truncates it.
specialValueProof.infinity: ABS maps either infinity sign to positive infinity. Safe binary32 addition with non-NaN nonnegative contributors retains positive-infinity class; finite overflow may also publish positive infinity.
specialValueProof.nan: ABS preserves exponent and payload fields while clearing only sign. N=1 stores those raw bits directly. For N>1, the signed NaN premise is constrained to L1-reachable operands: a NaN may carry either sign, while every non-NaN source or intermediate operand is sign-clear; safe addition then publishes NaN class without a finite fallback.
specialValueProof.daz: The formal primitive relation enumerates exact input or same-sign zero only for a subnormal input.
specialValueProof.ftz: The formal primitive relation enumerates exact rounded output or same-sign zero only for a subnormal rounded output.

formalProofBoundary.proved: Total raw classes; exact binary32 +1 word and class; exact ABS; complete set-valued DAZ/FTZ alternatives; an explicit finite nonnegative nearest-even relation in 2^-149 units including the overflow midpoint and even-retained-significand ties; the reachable-operand special NaN/positive-infinity/non-NaN/nonnegative class contract; a total signed finite nearest-even relation covering cancellation sign, both overflow signs, every finite/subnormal pair, and NaN/opposite-infinity/same-infinity classes; labelled contributor multiplicity; permitted left trees; N-1 L1 add nodes; N=1 direct ABS; L1 source-fold membership constrained by Binary32RneContract; the aggregate L1 nonnegative-or-NaN class invariant; reachable-source NaN absorption; positive-infinity persistence in a no-NaN fold; and SCATTER_ADD occurrence construction from exact source positions, strictly increasing filtered order, exact duplicate target/word multiplicity, raw base plus stable target-filtered occurrence membership constrained by GeneralBinary32RneContract, unaddressed raw identity, and injective one-writer target ownership.
formalProofBoundary.primitivePremise: Each audited hardware addition instantiates the shared addSite relation at its exact reachable source site. L1 additionally carries Binary32RneContract on its nonnegative-or-NaN reachable domain. Every SCATTER_ADD primitive result carries GeneralBinary32RneContract and therefore satisfies exactRneGeneral for every arbitrary raw operand pair before the shared exact-or-DAZ operand and exact-or-FTZ publication alternatives. Each addressed target result is the set-valued source-position-ordered site chain over its arbitrary raw base and every matching arbitrary raw update word. The audited MTLMathModeSafe/MTLLanguageVersion3_2 runtime sites and compiled unflagged AIR fadds supply compiler-site evidence.
formalProofBoundary.forbiddenAssumptions: Both Lean files compile without sorry or axiom declarations. The L1 generic NaN theorem retains its reachable-operand premises. The SCATTER_ADD theorem constructs occurrence ordinals from source-list positions and proves filtered payload preservation rather than assuming order labels, commutativity, associativity, uniqueness, canonical NaNs, or a deterministic exceptional-value bit pattern.

proof.runtimeCompilationAndExecution: MetalL1NormNativeTest and MetalScatterAddNativeTest passed on Apple M3 Max. SCATTER_ADD covered canonical INT32/INT64 materialized index feeds, duplicate source order, bit-exact unaddressed signed-zero/subnormal/NaN copies, addressed normal/subnormal/infinity/NaN classes, complete positive and negative range rejection before output mutation, and runtime handle-alias rejection. Its direct raw-native rejection matrix covers strict profile, MPSGraph route, nonzero axis, missing or malformed axis kind/count/value attributes, absent index feeds, independently gradient-marked data/indices/updates/output, all six pairwise role-value-ID aliases, wrong type/rank/layout for every role, unequal index/update and base/output extents, zero D, zero U, D FLOAT32 byte overflow, U INT32 count and byte overflow, and U INT64 byte overflow.
